div.style: color: rgb(96, 68, 14) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Auto mode removes only optional review acceptance.
Manual mode adds that gate before cloud review.
Maintenance / protected data never enter the cloud lane.
Independent work can continue while publication waits.

svg.text: Governed task lifecycle · local execution, reuse and publication
